about: Every source behind the Town app's Alerts tab: what it gives, whether scripts/town/alerts.py fetches it, and what stays manual.

sources.name: Recycling pickup day and parking-ban zone by street
sources.how: Query all 436 street segments: FACILITYID (street), Day, PARKINGBAN (zone A-H), Zone (route).
sources.notes: This is the layer behind the city's 'Find Your Recycling Day' map. It has no house-number ranges, so a long street split across days shows twice; the page should send those readers to the map. Stale date is worth a check with DPW (802-863-9094) before launch.

sources.name: Find Your Recycling Day (map)
sources.how: Link for address lookups.
sources.notes: Reader-facing fallback for split streets.

sources.name: Recycling & Solid Waste Collection page
sources.how: Read by hand each season.
sources.notes: Weekly city recycling in covered carts, curbside by 7am. Trash is private haulers only (no city trash day). Five no-pickup holidays: Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; weekend-holiday shifts are in the Holiday List on /277/Forms-Documents. Solid Waste Generation Tax rose to $12/month per unit in FY26.

sources.name: DPW holiday list
sources.how: Copy the holiday shifts into the app once a year.
sources.notes: Needed for 'recycling is a day late this week' alerts.

sources.name: CSWD Drop-Off Center in Burlington
sources.how: Regex the 'Hours of Operation' block; also captures the site-wide access notice.
sources.notes: Tue-Sat 8am-3:30pm on 2026-10-29. CSWD news feed https://cswd.net/feed/ carries holiday closures.

sources.name: CSWD news feed
sources.how: Could be keyword-scanned for 'closed' around holidays.
sources.notes: Not wired; low value until holiday season.

sources.name: Winter Parking rules page
sources.how: Rules copied into alerts.json parking_ban.rules; re-read each November.
sources.notes: Bans are called by 3 PM; 10 PM-7 AM citywide, midnight-6 AM in downtown Zone F; $75 ticket + $75 tow; free garage parking 7 PM-9 AM at Marketplace, Downtown and Lakeview; surface lots closed 2:30-6 AM Dec 1-Mar 15; seasonal one-side restrictions on seven streets Dec 1-Apr 1.

sources.name: City Alert Center RSS
sources.how: Scan titles and summaries for 'snow ban' / 'parking ban' (and lifted/cancelled), last 72 hours.
sources.notes: Empty on 2026-10-29 (fine outside winter). robots.txt allows RSSFeed.aspx for generic agents with a 10 s crawl delay but blocks it for named AI crawlers; the script identifies as btownbrief.com and waits 10 s between city requests.

sources.name: City News Flash RSS (all departments)
sources.how: Same keyword scan; also used by Since You Checked news.py.
sources.notes: Short rolling window (~10 items).

sources.name: Snow Ban Line 802-658-SNOW, overhead parking-ban lights, VT-Alert
sources.how: Not machine-readable. The city calls the overhead lights the 'official notification'. Stephen could subscribe a Btown inbox to VT-Alert email and forward ban emails into the pipeline.
sources.notes: Decision for Stephen: whether to subscribe a project email to VT-Alert so ban emails can be parsed.

sources.name: Greenway plowing and condition status
sources.how: Five bike-path segments: Plowing_Status, Ski_Condition, Condition_Notes, LastPlowedDate.
sources.notes: Last edited 2026-03-25; will wake up with the first snow.

sources.name: DPW plow and salt truck tracks (trial)
sources.how: Layers SpreaderTracks and PlowingTracks with 'Plowed < 1 Hour Ago' classes, 97 and 136 records from one morning, 2026-01-29.
sources.notes: Evidence the city has AVL plow data. A street plow map is possible if DPW publishes it; worth asking DPW (Stephen's call).

sources.name: Snow & Ice Control Plan
sources.how: Read once for the 'how plowing works' explainer (priority routes).
sources.notes: Linked from /610/Snowfighting-Program.

sources.name: NBC5 Closings & Delays
sources.how: The page embeds closingsData {closings:[], total} in its JSON state. Script filters names against the Burlington-area district list.
sources.notes: Empty on 2026-10-29, so the field names inside a closing entry are not yet seen; the parser tries name/organization/title and status/message. Check on the first delay day.

sources.name: WCAX Closings
sources.how: Server-rendered GSync closings block; script regexes 'Org  Closed/Delayed' pairs in the block text.
sources.notes: Unverified until a real closing day; treat as backup to NBC5.

sources.name: Burlington School District news feed
sources.how: Posts in the last 36 h whose title says delay/closed/early release/remote.
sources.notes: BSD's primary closing channel is ParentSquare messages and calls to families, which are not public; the website post can lag.

sources.name: Surrounding district websites
sources.publisher: South Burlington, Winooski, CVSD, Essex Westford, Colchester, Milton
sources.how: sbschools.net, ewsd.org and mtsd-vt.org answer scripts with a bot challenge ('Client Challenge'); wsdvt.org has /feed/; cvsdvt.org and csdvt.org are plain HTML. TV closings lists cover all of them.
sources.notes: Links: https://www.sbschools.net/ https://www.wsdvt.org/ https://www.cvsdvt.org/ https://www.ewsd.org/ https://www.csdvt.org/ https://www.mtsd-vt.org/

sources.name: City resource list: Housing and Shelter
sources.how: Standing list: COTS (802-864-7402, 24/7; Waystation year-round overnight shelter; Winter Warming Station, January to May in the season its impact report covers), ANEW Place Elmwood Community Shelter (year-round, low barrier), Champlain Housing Trust, DCF General Assistance emergency housing incl. cold-weather exceptions, Vermont 2-1-1.
sources.notes: Use for the Shelters tab's always-on list.

sources.name: Warming/cooling center announcements
sources.how: Keyword scan (warming center/station, cooling center, overflow shelter, adverse weather) over Alert Center + News Flash, last 14 days.
sources.notes: Openings are often announced only on social media or by COTS; a nightly check of cotsonline.org and 2-1-1 by hand during cold snaps is the gap.

sources.name: Vermont DCF emergency housing (adverse weather conditions)
sources.publisher: Vermont Department for Children and Families
sources.how: Returns 403 to scripts (bot protection). The state declares adverse-weather nights that open motel vouchers; announcements go through DCF press releases and 2-1-1.
sources.notes: Manual during cold snaps.

sources.name: Vermont 2-1-1
sources.how: Phone 2-1-1; site search is interactive.
sources.notes: Reader-facing link.

sources.name: NWS alerts (already tracked)
sources.how: Already in Since You Checked weather.py; the Alerts tab should read data/changes/changes.json for weather rather than refetch.
sources.notes: No new work.
